title: TiCube SMP
description: Modpack created for the SMP TiCube originally created for CurseForge by AlexCrissdefou
body:
![Ticube S6 Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2c9eaa9636f783fa72e04554622db00aebc69cc_0.webp)
# GOAL
This modpack includes QOL mods for a vanilla Minecraft server including a minimap (Journey map) , Simple voice chat, performance mods and shaders! Nice way to have a smooth and easy experience!
### Site WEB: [https://ticube.yolasite.com/](https://ticube.yolasite.com/)

# FEATURING
## Incredible chunk management engine such as:
- Lithium.
- Sodium.
- Sodium Extra.
- Threads.
- Spark. 

## Other mods :
- Iris Shaders (with complentary shaders in the modpack)
- Bobby Mod (Make you see further than server max render distance)
- Wavey capes (add wind effect to capes)
- Falling leaves
- Jade (to see what block you are looking at)
- BetterF3
- Mouse Tweaks (easier transfer of items with the mouse)
- More mouse tweaks
- Client sort (to sort item in a simple click)
- Apple skin (to see saturation of the food)
- Spyglass Improvment (Make the spyglass usefull!)
- Litematica (to make schematic of your builds)
- Borderless fullscreen
- Chat Heads (see player heads icon in chat)
- Controlling
- Gamma Utils (Make you control Minecraft gamma as you wich)
- Inventory Profiles Next
- JourneyMAP (Minimap mod)
- ModMenu
- Roughly enough items
- Searchables.
- Shulkerbox tooltip
- Skin Layer 3D
- Simple Voice Chat.
- And a few others !

This modpack doesnt change too much from the vanilla minecraft but add Quality Of Life mods to enhance the experience. This modpack was made for a French-Canadian (from Quebec) server in 1.21.3 called Ticube.
